title: No blood glucose data by selecting Ottai in Config Builder
body:
Smartphone: Pixel 5
AAPS v3.3.1.0
Ottai v1.1.1.250301 (international version)

Ottai CGM is working fine. It sends data to the Ottai app. 

I used instructions at AAPS docs for installing Ottai app. https://androidaps.readthedocs.io/en/latest/CompatibleCgms/OttaiM8.html

After selecting Ottai app as BG source no BG data goes to the AAPS app.

comments.body:
@MilosKozak @ottai-developer 

I resolved an issue. As it turned out guide at AAPS docs isn't full. 
In Ottai app you have to manually go to **Profile->Ottai Hub** and switch **Share with AAPS** toggle to **Enable**. 
After that all new BG data will go to the AAPS app.
